## Dajna (CR 8)

This titanic camel is covered in long, coarse russet hair. Its head reaches to the treetops and beyond and its tread is like thunder.  

**XP** 4,800  
N Gargantuan magical beast  
**Init** +0; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +17  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 6, flat-footed 20 (+14 natural, –4 size)  
**hp** 105 (10d10+50)  
**Fort** +12, **Ref** +7, **Will** +9  
**Resist** electricity 20, sonic 20  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft.  
**Melee** bite +15 (2d8+9/19–20 plus grab), hooves +13 (2d6+4 plus trip), tail slap +13 (1d8+4)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** fling, spit thunder, stomp, trample (2d6+13, DC 24)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 29, **Dex** 10, **Con** 20, **Int** 2, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 9  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +23 (+25 bull rush, +27 grapple); **CMD** 33 (35 vs. bull rush, 37 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack  
**Skills** Perception +17  
**SQ** mother’s milk, temper temper  


**Special Abilities**



**Fling (Ex)** When a dajna has grappled a creature with its bite, as a move action it can hurl the creature up to 10 feet in the air and 20 feet away, causing the creature to take 3d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone when it lands. If another creature is in the square where the creature lands, that creature also takes 3d6 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 24 Reflex half). The save DC is Strength-based.  

**Mother’s Milk (Su)** A female thunder camel can produce heavenly tasting yellowish milk. A creature that drinks the milk within 24 hours of its production gains the benefits of the heal spell, which also cures mundane problems like baldness and other superficial physical imperfections. It can produce one dose of mother’s milk each day.  

**Stomp (Ex)** As a standard action, a dajna stomps on a prone creature within its reach. The target takes 6d6+12 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 24 Reflex half). The dajna can also use its attack of opportunity to stomp an opponent standing from prone. The save DC is Strength-based.  

**Temper Temper (Su)** For one minute after a dajna takes damage, it gains the benefits of the haste spell. Once within that duration when it would fail a Will save, as an immediate action it can choose to reroll that saving throw, taking the result of this second save even if it is worse. If the dajna is affected by calm emotions or similar magic, it loses its benefits from haste for the duration of calming effect.  

**Thunderous Spit (Su)** Once every 1d6 rounds as a standard action, a dajna utters a deafening cough that is audible within 1 mile, dealing 4d6 points of sonic damage (DC 20 Fortitude half) to all creatures within 20 feet. It then expectorates a spitball of tremendous size and spews it in a 60-foot line. Each creature in the area takes 4d6 points of electricity damage and 4d6 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 20 Reflex half). The creature in the area farthest from the dajna is entangled in viscous fluid, taking 1d6 points of nonlethal damage and 1d6 points of electricity damage each round at the start of its turn. It gains a new Reflex save each round at the end of its turn to end the effect, and also can escape the spitball with a DC 20 Strength check. The save DC is Constitution-based.  


**About**
